title: Dagster Fundamentals for Precision Livestock Technology
text:
Welcome
Audience
Researchers building precision livestock analytics, often in R.
Goal
By the end, participants can:

Explain core Dagster concepts (assets, jobs, schedules)
Materialize an API-based asset
Schedule recurring API ingestion
Integrate R scripts into a Python-orchestrated pipeline

title: Dagster Fundamentals for Precision Livestock Technology
text:
Why Dagster for Livestock Research?

Data arrives continuously: sensors, climate feeds, herd events
Reproducibility is critical for scientific workflows
Asset lineage helps explain how datasets were produced
Schedules and automation reduce manual refresh work

title: Dagster Fundamentals for Precision Livestock Technology
text: Core Concepts

title: Dagster Fundamentals for Precision Livestock Technology
text:
Asset
A durable data product, for example:

Daily barn environment summary
Animal movement anomaly table
API snapshot from a welfare endpoint

title: Dagster Fundamentals for Precision Livestock Technology
text:
Job
A selection of assets to execute together.

title: Dagster Fundamentals for Precision Livestock Technology
text:
Schedule
A cron-like trigger that runs a job automatically.

title: Dagster Fundamentals for Precision Livestock Technology
text:
Live Demo 3: Scheduled API Call
Asset: scheduled_livestock_api

Job: scheduled_livestock_job
Schedule: daily_livestock_schedule (0 9 * * * UTC)

In Dagster UI:

Open Automation / Schedules
Enable daily_livestock_schedule
Trigger a manual tick for demonstration

title: Dagster Fundamentals for Precision Livestock Technology
text:
Suggested Extensions

Replace demo API with farm-specific endpoint
Add validation checks (missing fields, stale timestamp)
Partition by date for historical backfills
Store outputs in cloud object storage

title: Dagster Fundamentals for Precision Livestock Technology
text:
Common Pitfalls

Rscript not found on PATH
R package jsonlite missing
API latency/timeouts without retries
Forgetting timezone assumptions in schedules
